environment.power_settings: Not detected; record manually for the final study.

source.note: Source hashes identify executed files even when changes are uncommitted.

metadata.prediction_endorsement: AI-assisted proposals; student endorsement not verified by the runner.
metadata.timing_scope: Complete solver calls, common wrapper and result list retention; excludes validation and I/O.
metadata.batch_rule: Batch up to configured size only after a completed warm-up below threshold; warmups=0 means one call.
metadata.timeout_policy: Cooperative, not a hard deadline. Mixed-status batches retained and excluded from completed timing.

notes: Primary group summaries exclude relabellings to avoid counting them as independent random graphs.
Completed exact runtimes and paired approximation runtimes use identical fully completed instance subsets.
Interrupted runtimes are observed work, not time-to-optimality. Completion fractions expose censoring.
Quality ratios require a measured certified optimum greater than zero; empty and unproved cases are null.
Timing batches retain results and include common wrapper overhead; this is not a memory benchmark.
